description: The line plot illustrates the average performance percentage of three different metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across various data sizes ranging from 70m to 7.0B. The x-axis, labeled "Data Size," is linear and spans from 70m to 7.0B, with tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis, labeled "Avg. Performance (%)", ranges from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20, starting from 0 up to 80. The Precision metric is represented by a red line with triangle markers, the Recall metric by a blue line with square markers, and the F1-score by a purple line with pentagon markers. The Precision line starts at approximately 80% at 70m and shows a slight decline as data size increases, ending around 70% at 7.0B. The Recall line begins at around 20% at 70m and exhibits a steady increase, reaching about 60% at 7.0B. The F1-score line starts at approximately 10% at 70m and also shows a consistent upward trend, ending near 50% at 7.0B.
